procedural_matters: CHN was represented by Moning Xu (helm)
CAN was represented by Alvin Wang (helm)
Lin Lu (CHN team leader) attended the hearing as an observer.
Nicolas Tosi (CAN coach) attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: CHN returned ashore as last of the Nacra fleet.
Once ashore the helm of CHN washed the boat and then collected the mobile to submit the protest.
The mobile of the helm of CHN was in the car parked in the boat park 200m far from boat parking place.
The protest time limit for the Mixed Two Person Multihull was 15:43.
There were no damages nor injuries.
conclusions: CHN failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1).
There was no good reason for the International Jury to extend the time limit. Therefore the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(a).
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
